blocking_codes.PIC: Preferred Interexchange Carrier — toll/long distance carrier assignment
blocking_codes.NO PIC: No carrier for toll or long distance
blocking_codes.COMPLETE: Complete caller ID blocking — number shows PRIVATE on caller ID
blocking_codes.SEL: Selective Blocking — number WILL appear on caller ID
blocking_codes.INTL: Block international calls (PTC stopped offering international Jan 2019)
blocking_codes.NP: Non-published — number not listed in directory
blocking_codes.NO FEATURES: No special switch features or blocks

field_guide.CBR: Call Back Reach number — customer's contact number, provided by customer or from voicemail/application. Can be out-of-area. Shows on SO ticket in the Contact Number field on Office Information tab.
field_guide.DUE_DATE: Complete By Date field on SO Office Information tab. The deadline for the ENTIRE workflow (all tasks, not just E.FACS). Includes AM/PM time window.
field_guide.agreement_search: You don't search separately — the SO screen shows Account, Customer, Agreement fields. The Agmt tab has full agreement details. Facilities tab shows the service point facilities.
field_guide.facs_update: Facilities tab on SO → Switch dropdown → Taqua → enter new Switch/Cable/Pair/Parent Equip/PED → Save. For disconnect: Service Points tab → select SP → Disconnect Service Point. Connect/Disconnect buttons on Service Points tab.
field_guide.edge_system: NOT a separate system. Uses iVUE + LinePacks + As-Built DWG (I:\Eng_GIS\GEO_Drawings\PonderosaEdge_Millerton_WorkOrderVersion.dwg). 125-prefixed agreements. EDGE orders in H:\Ponderosa Edge Project\EDGE ORDERS.
field_guide.heatmap: CNHeat is a Tarana wireless tool showing signal coverage/strength heatmaps. It is NOT a LinePacks feature. Used for Tarana wireless inquiries to estimate received power and coverage.

pic_pair_records.purpose: Build PIC-Pair records for as-built schematics in the cable book
procedure: Search for Route ID in Oasis
Right-click in gray area → select 'Facility Builder'
Facility Connection Wizard opens: (remote) CO on left, 'To Junction' at top, next available out records from To Junction
If no records in 'To' cable → select 'Create Facility' at bottom
Dialogue shows PIC count, status, wirecenter

fix_remove.WARNING: DO NOT open Facility Table directly in database — it WILL crash Access!
steps: Open stored procedure in design view
Change ROUTE_Name criteria to = N 'LLLL-NNNNNN' (e.g. NFRK-123456)
This narrows hundreds of thousands of records to just that cable

procedures_extra.title: Find a vacant pair — NewNetCMS SQL view
procedures_extra.body: NewNetCMS has a queryable view [NewNetCMS].[dbo].[IVUE_CablePair_Facs_Copper] that joins cables, pairs, equipment, agreements, addresses, speeds, bonding, X-connects and pending SOs into one flat row — this is how cutsheets are built and how you look up the full state of any cable pair. Filter e.g. [Cable Name]='SVLK-1' and pair between 900 and 1200; ORDER BY pair+0 asc (the +0 forces a numeric sort). Key columns: Pair Status, Bonded, XConn Cable Nm / XConn Pair, MinSvPt_BP / MaxSvPt_BP / Port_BP / BND_Port_BP, Serving Ped Parent Equip Name, CBOL, SubDown / SubUp, PendingSOs.

procedures_extra.title: Path Trace (iVUE)
procedures_extra.body: Captures assignment data the Service Point screen can't. COPPER assignments: X-connect + X-connect pairs. FIBER assignments: power-pair + Feeder Fiber + Splitter + GPON assignments. Tutorial video: I:\Eng_GIS\Training\GIS Training Library\GIS Track\Facility Assignments\Pathtrace.

procedures_extra.title: Pic-Pair records (as-built) + the Access gotcha
procedures_extra.body: BUILD: in Oasis select the 'line' cable leaving the (remote) CO, search the Route ID, open it, right-click the gray area -> Facility builder -> Facility Connection Wizard; if the 'To' cable has no records, Create Facility (set pic count, status, wirecenter). FIX / REMOVE: do NOT open the Facility table in the database directly -- it WILL crash Access. Instead use the 'Pic-Pair-Fix_sp' stored procedure: in design view set ROUTE_Name = N'LLLL-NNNNNN' (e.g. NFRK-123456) to narrow hundreds of thousands of records to just that copper.
